description.default: Render Mermaid diagrams with the official Mermaid 12.3.0 engine instead of the version bundled with SiYuan (11.16.1 on 3.8.6 and earlier, 12.2.0 from 3.8.8). Diagrams keep rendering inline through SiYuan's native pipeline, so editing, the reload button, fold-deferred rendering and syntax error messages all behave as before. Adds theme, look, font size, htmlLabels and useMaxWidth settings that SiYuan hard-codes.
description.zh-CN: 用 Mermaid 官方 12.3.0 引擎渲染图表，替代思源内置版本（3.8.6 及更早是 11.16.1，3.8.8 起是 12.2.0）。仍走思源原生渲染流程，代码块在文档中直接渲染为图形，编辑、刷新按钮、折叠延迟渲染、语法报错提示行为与原生一致。额外提供主题、外观风格、字号、HTML 标签、宽度自适应等思源写死的配置项。
